---
title: "Recommended packages"
---

This page describes how the translations of the [recommended packages](https://translate.rx.studio/projects/the-r-project-recommended-packages/#components) contributed on Weblate are sent upstream.

Unlike base R, these translations are not part of the [quarterly patch for R Core](Weblate-server.qmd#quarterly-patch-for-r-core).
Each package has its own maintainer and repository, so the contributions need to be sent to each one separately, as a pull request or as a patch.

## Tracking

For each round of contributions, open an issue in the [translations repo](https://github.com/r-devel/translations/issues) for tracking, listing the status of each package. 
See, for example, [r-devel/translations#68](https://github.com/r-devel/translations/issues/68).
## Decisions

These are decisions discussed by the team, and they can be revisited if needed.

### New source strings (`.pot` and `.po` files)

When a package changes (e.g. new or modified messages), its `.pot` and `.po` files need to be regenerated (e.g. with `tools::update_pkg_po()`), so that these messages show up in Weblate to be translated.
We don't do this for the recommended packages: it is left to each package's maintainer, and Weblate picks up the new source strings on its next fetch from upstream.
So the contributions sent upstream should include only the translations.
See the discussion in [r-devel/translations#69](https://github.com/r-devel/translations/issues/69).
